evidence_candidates.excerpt: The FugakuNEXT basic design calls for broad component-level water cooling, high-temperature free cooling, load-responsive flow control, and joint optimization of building, CDU, and computing systems. It also identifies floor loading, seismic measures, delivery routes, cabling, and piping as constraints.
evidence_candidates.statement_supported: FugakuNEXT facility planning explicitly co-designs cooling, power response, floor loading, seismic safety, and maintainability.
